root_cause.impact: All hermes_local agents had empty adapterConfig, so model resolution delegated to Hermes config.yaml. The config's fallback_providers listed OpenRouter before local Ollama, causing qwen3-coder:30b 404s. Fixed by changing DEFAULT_MODEL to ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b. However, 10 agents remain errored with empty adapterConfig even after the fix — the runtime bootstrap fails before model resolution completes (CLI hang + DB contention). The credential/provider injection (JAC-4655) and adapterConfig pinning (JAC-4657) are the remaining recovery steps.
root_cause.resolution: DEFAULT_MODEL changed to 'ollama-launch/qwen3-coder:30b' (commit 2f5ff6345), deployed in npm package v2026.722.0. ErrorReason truncation fixed (81da996fa). Remaining: JAC-4655 (credential injection), JAC-4657 (adapterConfig batch patch), JAC-4656 (CLI bootstrap hang fix).

re_verification.summary: Fresh live verification at 01:02Z confirms: 68 total agents, 10 hermes_local in error (oscillating 6-9), all with adapterConfig={}. 3 root causes persist: (1) DB write contention (Operator sqlite3.OperationalError database is locked), (2) process lifecycle failures (Coordinator 'Process lost'), (3) null errorReason (5 agents — error before errorReason is set). ErrorReason fixes are deployed and verified working (0 stale entries on running/idle). Scout decommission complete. Remaining recovery under JAC-4655 (in_progress), JAC-4657 (in_progress), JAC-4656 (todo), JAC-4686 (backlog).
